items.text: While everyone's stunning performance as the new Governors of Resthaven, not to mention their behind-the-scenes investigations, has had an immeasurable effect in pushing back the curse that besets the island, there have been a number of unforeseen side effects of the time loop and the intervention of our benevolent/malevolent (still unknown) island benefactor.

Behind the scenes, we've done our best to clean up the eldritch messes and ensure that you may continue your investigation, all while administering to the colony without encountering any unusual (or, at least, more unusual than expected!) bugs.

(In all seriousness, a massive thank you to everyone who's taken the time to share their findings with us. Your reports and feedback have been invaluable in helping us make the game as good as it can possibly be. The Hilltop team has been genuinely moved by the generosity, enthusiasm, and collaboration of this community!)
The Merchant Captain relationship indicator now clearly shows when you've reached the maximum relationship level (10) on the trading screen.
Fixed game not penalizing merchants’ level when submitting an extreme price while the Interrogator boon card is active.
Fixed a bug causing unintended character portraits to appear during the merchant conspiracy scene.
Fixed a bug causing Renee to repeat herself during her Day 6 reintroduction.
The game now automatically saves after receiving a clue from Agata.
Fixed bug causing Friedrich at the tavern to present the option to share findings about the ledger at the incorrect time.
Fixed a Day 4 afternoon timeline event that remained marked as ??? indefinitely.
Fixed a bug causing the button hold sound effect to play endlessly when right-clicking while holding left-click on the button.
Fixed a bug that occasionally caused market conditions to reshuffle when a profile was loaded.
Corrected a handful of typos and addressed several other minor issues.
We’re going to have to be a little careful with how we word this one, as we don’t want to spoil anything. So please bear with us as today’s patch notes are a touch... cryptic.
Adjusted the introduction flow if you encounter the character on day at [REDACTED LOCATION].
Added a flower to the Governor’s manor that changes depending on .
Resolved a small number of typos and minor details.
We sincerely hope these notes are clear, informative, and helpful. You’re welcome!

First, a huge thank you to the wonderful Curse of Resthaven community for putting the game through its paces and sharing your discoveries, feedback, and bug reports with us. We're committed to making the game as good as it can possibly be, and the players who've jumped in, connected with us, and taken the time to share their experiences this week have been an enormous help. We genuinely appreciate it.

notes.title: Here's what's improved in this patch

items.text: Slightly improved the render quality of the Docks & Downtown background art.
Fixed bug that sometimes made it impossible to free-claim/buy some resources with the town local vendors.
Fixed “Through the Mist” expedition causing Garet’s cursed portrait to persist if played on day 6.
Fixed some cases where Friedrich, Joan, Dirk, Marit, Micah names could remain unrevealed and shown as ‘???’ when they shouldn’t be.
Fixed bug in Lead-Lined Box skill that sometimes caused resources to be lost after the cataclysm.
Fixed exploit that made it possible to save resources between loops by assigning them to ships in the trading setup screen right before the cataclysm.
Fixed "Vendor Elevation" skill upgrading vendors beyond level 4.
Fixed bug allowing you to input/change the target time of day after beginning the time skip sequence.
Fixed bug that sometimes caused a faceless governor’s portrait to be shown during questioning (this was an unintentionally creepy one!)
Adjusted Iryna’s presence data to fix a story continuity issue.
Fixed local vendors sometimes showing incorrect amounts in inventory for each resource.
Fixed bug that caused merchants to sometimes bid a price they're not willing to accept when selling to you a resource with current low market price.
Fixed edge case in expedition “The Merchant From Elsewhere Pt. 2” that could lead to a softlock under very specific conditions.
Other minor fixes and adjustments.
Bard music is now interrupted after the end of day screen.
Fixed typos in some dialogue lines.
Fixed visual glitch that happened when fast traveling from the outskirts creek to the lab.
Fixed UI navigation issue in the trading stocking screen when selecting ships.
Fixed vendors UI not refreshing correctly after purchasing the “Vendor Elevation” skill.
Fixed game intro soft lock that happened if you managed to talk to Sweeney instead of Garet right after arriving at the docks.
Fixed Garet’s day 6 cursed portrait lingering too long if you speak to him and then chose not to start the cataclysm.
Updated some lead titles.
Fixed soft lock that happened when entering the trusted merchants conspiracy meeting under very specific conditions.
Fixed exploit that allowed you to duplicate resources.
Other minor fixes.
